imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The swim-trunks guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 412 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 28.22. The sitemap snapshot reported 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs without errors or warnings, while the current repository inventory already contained 260 canonical sitemap URLs.
searchConsole.decision: No page is labeled Data-led because the query and page samples were not repeatable enough. The discovery discrepancy instead drove architecture: all three distinct evergreen pages are linked from the homepage, Library and their department hubs, supported by twelve reciprocal contextual links, and emitted into a regenerated 263-URL sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: One impression for ‘beard system’ at position 4, three combined impressions for two CDC jet-lag queries at positions 7–8, one public-Wi-Fi impression at position 19 and four capsule-wardrobe impressions at position 9 were deliberately ignored as too small, already served or unrelated to today’s portfolio.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the swim-trunks guide: shorter trunks, mid-length trunks and fixed-waist board shorts. The trainer and lighting manuals remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready personal-trainer consultation, credential, scope, paid-trial and contract record. It separates accreditation from an individual credential, coaching from medical care, observed session quality from marketing, and the program plan from payment and cancellation terms.
authority.cluster: The Fitness service cluster now connects gym-contract review, program progression, exercise substitution and return-to-training guidance to a verified professional-selection handoff. Style connects swimwear fit and care to shorts, sunscreen, sunglasses and travel packing. Life connects lighting labels and room tasks to energy review, wall-art placement, tool planning and electrical-cord safety.
authority.opportunity: No outreach opportunity was logged: the highest-value action was the on-site trainer-selection asset, its primary-source verification routes and reciprocal cluster reinforcement. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Style, Fitness and Life: which swim-trunk construction fits a specific body and water job; how to verify and contract with a personal trainer without confusing certification with medical authority; and how to specify brightness, color, glare, fixture compatibility and controls for a room. Swim trunks serve natural purchase intent, the trainer file expands professional-service authority, and the lighting worksheet explores a fresh home-and-taste problem. Analytics shaped crawl architecture rather than topics because its samples were too weak.
